bots.beginner: Makes efficiency mistakes and never folds. Good for learning the flow.
bots.club: Solid tile efficiency, claims when it helps, basic defence.
bots.pro: Fast and efficient, folds against ready players and keeps scoring tiles.

boot.title: This device cannot run fair games
boot.body: Mahjong Madness needs the system's secure random number generator to shuffle fairly, and it is not available here. Please update the app or your device's system software.
